data.name: Spirits: Unbound
data.detailed_description:
Build your Spirit Team:

Put your deck-building skills to the test, and build a deck consisting of 5 unique spirit lines. Balance speed with damage, and try to have a good coverage of the 9 different elemental types. Then put it to the test against other players in a TCG that rewards thinking ahead. Lock in moves at the same time as your opponent, constantly attempting to outplay them, as you watch your actions play out in speed order.

Augment your Spirit Team (Coming soon):

Apply stickers, and collect special power-ups between matches to push your spirit team’s synergy to the extreme levels. Spirit cards overlap, inheriting abilities and stats, so your upgrades always matter, as you shift your cards through 3 different forms.

Expand your Spirit Collection (coming soon):

Open packs, and gain new cards, with a gameplay friendly collection system. All cards are easily obtainable, with rarity being tied to cosmetic variation. Collect amazing looking cards, with unique cosmetic effects, and trade them with your friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with Vulkan support (Intel HD 630 / AMD Radeon Vega 8 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Only if you want sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Probably
